What We Build

One Partner. Multiple Ways to Reimagine Your Venue.

From fast, flexible athletic support spaces to premium outdoor hospitality, we help plan improvements around what your facility needs and what it could become.

Modular Athletic Infrastructure

Shipping container based press boxes, observation decks, equipment facilities, support spaces and adaptable venue structures for schools and athletic programs.

Premium Outdoor Environments

Architectural shade, motorized pergolas, cabanas and gathering areas that extend the comfort and usability of outdoor spaces.

Hospitality & Revenue Spaces

VIP viewing, sponsor entrances, alumni gathering spaces, event areas and opportunities for premium access and commercial activation.

Meet the Founder

William L. Bowman

Founder & Chief Deal Architect

Bill Bowman's connection to athletics is more than a career—it's a lifelong legacy rooted in one of college football's most celebrated traditions.

Raised in a football coaching family, Bill is the son of Dick Bowman, a two-way player for the University of Oklahoma under legendary coach Bud Wilkinson. Dick blocked for 1952 Heisman Trophy winner Billy Vessels and helped lay the foundation for Oklahoma's historic 47-game winning streak. Drafted by the New York Giants, he played under NFL icons Tom Landry and Vince Lombardi before pursuing a distinguished coaching career and eventually leading professional and government sales for Rawlings Sporting Goods.

Growing up immersed in athletics and the facilities that support them, Bill developed an early understanding of the people, operations, and infrastructure behind successful sports programs. He carried that foundation to West Point, graduating from the United States Military Academy and serving as a U.S. Army officer.

Over the following decades, Bill built a diverse career spanning venue development, concert production, commercial financing, executive leadership, and complex enterprise sales. His experience combines hands-on operational knowledge with the ability to develop strategic partnerships and navigate sophisticated business opportunities.

Today, as Founder and Chief Deal Architect of STADIA IP, Bill brings together his athletic heritage, military leadership, extensive industry relationships, and decades of business experience to help athletic directors, university leaders, and commercial partners transform underutilized spaces into valuable, revenue-generating assets.
